summary: Dependency-confusion squat exfiltrates host identifiers at install time
details: file-saver-bg@9.9.9 is a dependency-confusion-shaped package (name resembles 'file-saver', implausibly high version 9.9.9 to win internal resolution) whose package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts invoking beacon.js. beacon.js collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), and os.platform() and transmits them as query parameters in an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://100.24.177.136/cb. The beacon fires automatically on npm install without any user interaction, disclosing internal build-host identifiers to an attacker-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
